svg.title: Nojoom Cars Auction — Editable Print Template
svg.desc: Original portrait proportions, gold and cream styling, original logo at top-left, editable auction number 1 at top-right, and an editable right-to-left Farsi vehicle table centered on the page. Original logo, phone icon, and Instagram QR are preserved as embedded raster artwork. All other visible text and graphic elements are native SVG. The chassis field retains the original six-digit reference, 231040.

g.aria-label: Original NCA AFG Branch, Nojoom Cars Auction logo
